_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tha thu na Chluicheach {player_id} ann an Tic Tac Toe trì-chluicheadair.
Tha do shiomball '{symbol}'.
Tha thu a' dol air do ghluasaid a chur air bòrd 5x5 gus sreath de cheithir a dhèanamh.
Faodaidh sreathan a bhith horizontach, verticach, no diaigoneach.
Cur thu do ghluasaid a-steach ann an riochd '[4]' gus comharra a chur air ceall 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Foirm gluasad neo-dhligheach. Cleachd "[cell]" far a bheil cealla 0 - {max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Àireamh cealla neo-dhligheach: {cell}. Feumaidh a bhith eadar 0 agus {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Tha cealla {cell} air a ghabhail os làimh mu thràth.

game_action.placed: Cluicheach {player_id} a' cur a shiomball ({symbol}) ann an raon ({row}, {col}).
